attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene

rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed less than 1 year as of May 31 of the renewal year - no CPE; 1 to 2 years - half of the required CPE.
rules.alternatives: Board may grant an exception in unusual circumstances (e.g. prolonged illness, extended absence from the country) on petition.
rules.audit_note: Electronic attestation at renewal; random audit each biennium - then upload certificates (name, course, provider, dates, hours) and current CPR card to DELPROS.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Scientific CPE incl. live webinars sponsored/approved by ADHA, ADA, ADAA, American Academy of Dental Hygiene, recognized dental/dental hygiene specialty societies and study clubs, accredited dental/dental hygiene schools, approved hospital programs, other Board-approved organizations
rules.legal_basis: 24 Del. Admin. Code 1100, Section 6.9-6.12 (24 Del.C. §1106(a)(1) and (7))
rules.notes: Licenses expire May 31 of even years. Self-study max 15 of 24 h (max 5 h without test, max 10 h with test incl. non-live online). Current hands-on CPR every 2 years. Local anesthesia permit holders: +2 h local anesthesia CE per renewal period.
